2315315.text: 2315315 arrived in 2025 and already plays like a fixture near the summit: tempo and bravery both near the top, accuracy and headshots close behind them, and the lifetime ledger among the very best tracked. The kill-death record in head-to-head fights sits well above average rather than leading the card, and resistance holds a step behind the rest. A fast-rising regular with almost no soft spots.

2333ooo.text: 2333OoO wins fights the aim alone would not explain: the matchup rating runs well above average, and tempo, bravery, and resistance run with it, while the lifetime kill-death line reaches the top shelf. The accuracy sits below average, while the lifetime IvI trails in the same lower ground — the shots miss more than most, yet the results keep coming. A regular whose judgment covers what the crosshair does not.

2andrey26.text: 2Andrey26 plays the steady middle of a strong card: well above average in the matchups, with pace and output above average too. The matchup kill-death arithmetic sits mid-pack; the lifetime board, the aim, and the headshots agree. The edge keeps its share against the toughest third, which keeps the story honest: a strong regular with no single headline.
